senses.definition: (manhwa, women's speech) An affectionate term of address for an older brother or somewhat older man.
(South Korean idol fandom) A male idol revered by a younger female fan.
examples: Sign #2- Changing your phone's, laptop's etc. wallpaper/lockscreen with your oppa's photo.

quotes.text: Your oppa from Boys Over Flowers and The Legend of the Blue Sea is back with a new album.
quotes.reference: 2017 June, “Cosmo Bae Lee Min Ho”, in Cosmopolitan, page 14:

quotes.text: My K-Pop bias.... CHIM CHIM OFCOURSE^([sic]). My oppa Jimin. <3 <3
